[[Luxon Ranger]]s are the [[Beast Mastery|beast-master]] members of the [[Luxon|Luxon Armada]]. They are allied to players in Jade Sea, and hostile when encountered in the Echovald Forest.

**{{NPC location|Melandru's Hope}} (only during [[Securing Echovald Forest]])
*[[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Gyala Hatchery|explorable area}}
